spec.name: Furniture Spider Stool
spec.description: A playful black spider stool with a flat plum-purple cushion, eight sturdy stepped legs and two little red eyes. Connected, axis-aligned furniture within one block; cushion top at y=14 and outer X/Z edges inset at least 0.25 units.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: playful black spider-shaped stool with a flat purple padded seat, eight short angular legs and two small red eyes on the front. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges. Seat cushion top must be at y=14 so a player can sit on it. Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
